decisions.reason: As a product line tightly linked to the core formwork business and initially important enough to merit its own page, it likely remains near aspiration levels or has been absorbed into broader system sales, so we would keep it despite reduced visibility.

With only limited prior website prominence, no later observation, and earlier pruning of related magnetic formwork items, this line now looks more likely to fall below aspiration levels than to justify continued attention and slack.

This narrower component was already the weakest survivor in 2019, and after two years without visible market presence the boundedly rational choice is to reallocate resources to the established business and newer development projects.
